de.fzi.sim.kascpar.sc2ast
Class SC2AST

java.lang.Object
  de.fzi.sim.kascpar.sc2ast.SC2AST

public class SC2AST
extends java.lang.Object

Generates a AST from input C/C++ and SystemC source files. The generated AST contains a token for each statement of the original sourse. The AST is represented as a XML tree and it is also possible to save this tree in the file. The class can be used as a program entry point (it has the main routine). There is also possible to use the SC2AST class in other Java sources.

setCommentsProcessing

public static void setCommentsProcessing(boolean value)
Registers a tool behaviour with the comments in the original source code.

Parameters:
value - - a behaviour with the comments. If the value is true all comments will be saved in the AST, otherwise each comment will be ignored.

setFileLineColumnSaving

public static void setFileLineColumnSaving(boolean value)
Registers a tool behaviour with the token position information (file, line, column) in the original source code.

Parameters:
value - - a behaviour with the token position. If the value is true a file, a line and a column will be saved as attributes in the nodes of the AST, otherwise this information will be ignored.

parse

public static org.w3c.dom.Document parse(java.util.ArrayList files,
                                         java.lang.String output_source_file,
                                         java.lang.String user_included_file,
                                         boolean printMsg)
Performs the parse of the input source files and the AST generation.

Parameters:
files - - input source files.
output_source_file - - an output common source file.This is the result of the gcc preprocessor call.
user_included_file - - a written by user header file with forward declaration of the used in the input source files data types from system(standart) headers.
printMsg - - controls messages output. If the printMsg is true the methods prints information into output stream, otherwise there is no message is put.
Returns:
a root of the AST if the method finished successfully, null otherwise.
